description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing what a subject does, including actions, habits and routines, through lexical verbs organized across sentence structures and time references.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar lo que hace un sujeto, incluyendo acciones, hábitos y rutinas, mediante verbos léxicos organizados a través de estructuras oracionales y referencias temporales.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar o que um sujeito faz, incluindo ações, hábitos e rotinas, por meio de verbos lexicais organizados através das estruturas da oração e das referências temporais.

metadata.notes: v0.1 treats Action as the Master verb-function associated with what a subject does. Routine and habit are treated as applications of Action rather than independent verb-functions. Lexical regular and irregular verbs will be managed through a separate verb lexicon instead of becoming child knowledge nodes.
